catalog.title: Advanced .NET test-case catalog (categories S-Z)
catalog.description: Extends catalog/dotnet-test-cases.json (A-R) with platform-specific, protocol-level and modern-stack attack surfaces. Written after auditing the A-R catalog and finding these classes absent. Same field contract as the base catalog.
catalog.note: A-R covers the OWASP-aligned core. S-Z covers what is specific to .NET as a platform: its serializers, its reflection surface, its legacy web stack, its RPC frameworks, the federation protocols it ships clients for, HTTP protocol-level issues, and runtime semantics that silently change security decisions.

categories.S: Unsafe reflection, type resolution and dynamic code execution
categories.T: ASP.NET platform internals (ViewState, crypto endpoints, path APIs, impersonation)
categories.V: WCF, SOAP and legacy service stacks
categories.W: Modern .NET surfaces (SignalR, gRPC, Blazor, Minimal API, hosted services)
categories.Y: HTTP protocol-level attacks (smuggling, host header, cache poisoning, splitting)
categories.Z: Runtime and platform semantics that change security outcomes

tests.title: Type.GetType with user-controlled input
tests.lookFor: Type.GetType / Type.GetTypeFromProgID / GetTypeFromCLSID fed from a request value
tests.expected: type resolved from a fixed allow-list, never from input

tests.title: Activator.CreateInstance on an attacker-named type
tests.lookFor: Activator.CreateInstance(Type.GetType(input)) or CreateInstance(assembly, typeName)
tests.expected: instantiation restricted to a known set

tests.title: Assembly.Load / LoadFrom / LoadFile with input
tests.lookFor: assembly path or bytes derived from a request or a writable location
tests.expected: no dynamic assembly loading from untrusted sources

tests.title: MethodInfo.Invoke on a user-selected method
tests.lookFor: GetMethod(input) followed by Invoke
tests.expected: dispatch via an explicit switch or a registered handler map

tests.title: XamlReader.Parse / Load on untrusted markup
tests.lookFor: XamlReader.Parse, XamlServices.Load with request data
tests.expected: never parse untrusted XAML; it is a direct code-execution primitive

tests.title: JavaScriptSerializer with SimpleTypeResolver
tests.lookFor: new JavaScriptSerializer(new SimpleTypeResolver())
tests.expected: no type resolver; it enables arbitrary type instantiation

tests.title: XmlSerializer constructed with a user-supplied type
tests.lookFor: new XmlSerializer(Type.GetType(input))
tests.expected: serializer type fixed at compile time

tests.title: DataContractSerializer/NetDataContract with open known-types
tests.lookFor: NetDataContractSerializer, or DataContractSerializer with a permissive DataContractResolver
tests.expected: NetDataContractSerializer never used on untrusted data; resolver allow-lists types

tests.title: YamlDotNet deserializing with type tags
tests.lookFor: Deserializer without a restricted type resolver; !! tags honoured
tests.expected: restricted deserializer; no arbitrary type construction

tests.title: MessagePack typeless / protobuf dynamic resolution
tests.lookFor: TypelessContractlessStandardResolver or equivalent dynamic type handling

tests.title: Newtonsoft SerializationBinder absent with TypeNameHandling
tests.lookFor: TypeNameHandling set with no custom SerializationBinder
tests.expected: TypeNameHandling.None, or a strict binder allow-list

tests.title: Deserialization gadget packages present
tests.lookFor: packages known to carry usable gadget chains reachable from a deserializer
tests.expected: no untrusted deserialization path exists at all

tests.title: Dynamic LINQ / expression parsing from input
tests.lookFor: System.Linq.Dynamic Where(string) or similar string-predicate APIs

tests.title: Reflection used to bypass access modifiers on security types
tests.lookFor: BindingFlags.NonPublic on auth or crypto types
tests.expected: no reflective access to security internals

tests.title: ViewState deserialization RCE
tests.lookFor: ViewState accepted without MAC, or machineKey known/leaked/predictable
tests.expected: MAC enforced, ViewState encrypted, machineKey secret and per-environment

tests.title: machineKey disclosed via config or error
tests.lookFor: machineKey in a committed config, a backup, or an exception page
tests.expected: never disclosed; rotate if it ever was

tests.title: Padding-oracle exposure via .axd handlers
tests.lookFor: unpatched ScriptResource.axd / WebResource.axd behaviour, or custom decryption returning distinct errors

tests.title: ViewStateUserKey not set
tests.lookFor: no ViewStateUserKey assignment, enabling one-click/CSRF on postbacks

tests.title: Server.MapPath with user input
tests.lookFor: MapPath(input) resolving to a filesystem path
tests.expected: no user-controlled virtual paths; containment asserted

tests.title: Virtual path / route injection
tests.lookFor: VirtualPathUtility or route values built from input

tests.title: Client impersonation misuse
tests.lookFor: WindowsIdentity.Impersonate / <identity impersonate="true"> with a privileged account
tests.expected: least-privilege app-pool identity; no blanket impersonation

tests.title: Impersonation context not reverted
tests.lookFor: Impersonate() without a using/finally Undo()

tests.title: Forms authentication cookie weaknesses
tests.lookFor: protection="None" or "Validation" only; cookieless mode; long timeout

tests.title: Cookieless sessions enabled

tests.title: Elmah / Trace / diagnostic handler exposed

tests.title: OutputCache varies incorrectly on authenticated content

tests.title: Static file handler serves application data directories

tests.lookFor: RazorEngine / RazorLight / Engine.Razor.RunCompile with a template from input

tests.lookFor: CSharpScript.EvaluateAsync / RunAsync with request data

tests.title: Runtime compilation via CodeDom
tests.lookFor: CSharpCodeProvider.CompileAssemblyFromSource with input

tests.title: Scriban / Fluid / DotLiquid template from input
tests.lookFor: Template.Parse(userInput) then Render

tests.title: Handlebars.Net template injection

tests.title: Template sandbox permits type access
tests.lookFor: member access to types, Assembly or Process from a template context
tests.expected: restricted member access; no reflection from templates

tests.lookFor: templates stored in a database and rendered server-side

tests.title: Expression evaluator exposed to end users
tests.lookFor: NCalc/DynamicExpresso expressions authored outside the trust boundary

tests.title: WCF metadata publishing enabled in production

tests.title: WCF includeExceptionDetailInFaults
tests.lookFor: serviceDebug includeExceptionDetailInFaults="true"

tests.title: WCF NetDataContractSerializer on a public endpoint
tests.lookFor: operation behaviour replacing the serializer

tests.title: WCF maxReceivedMessageSize / reader quotas unbounded

tests.title: SOAP endpoint without per-operation authorization

tests.title: ASMX legacy web service exposed

tests.title: XXE in a SOAP/WCF message reader

tests.title: SignalR group membership not authorized

tests.lookFor: AllowAnyOrigin plus AllowCredentials on the hub route

tests.title: SignalR message size / connection limits unbounded

tests.title: gRPC service without authorization
tests.lookFor: service or method lacking [Authorize]

tests.title: gRPC reflection enabled in production

tests.title: gRPC message size limits unbounded

tests.title: gRPC detailed errors leaked

tests.title: Blazor Server JSInterop with unsanitised content
tests.lookFor: InvokeVoidAsync into innerHTML-style sinks
tests.expected: no raw HTML injection from server state

tests.title: Blazor MarkupString from user content
tests.lookFor: (MarkupString)userValue

tests.title: Blazor Server circuit state trusted from client
tests.lookFor: authorization decisions based on component parameters

tests.title: Minimal API endpoint without authorization
tests.lookFor: MapGet/MapPost without RequireAuthorization and no fallback policy

tests.title: Hosted service swallows exceptions
tests.lookFor: BackgroundService ExecuteAsync with a bare catch
tests.expected: failures logged and surfaced; host stops or alerts

tests.title: Scoped service captured by a singleton
tests.lookFor: DbContext or scoped dependency injected into a singleton

tests.title: Health or metrics endpoint exposes internals
tests.lookFor: detailed health payload or /metrics reachable anonymously

tests.title: Developer secrets or user-secrets shipped
tests.lookFor: appsettings.Development.json or secrets.json in the artifact

tests.title: OAuth redirect_uri not strictly validated
tests.lookFor: prefix or wildcard matching of redirect_uri

tests.title: OAuth state parameter missing or unverified
tests.lookFor: authorization request without state, or state not compared on callback
tests.expected: random state, bound to the session, verified

tests.title: PKCE not used for public clients
tests.lookFor: authorization code flow without code_challenge

tests.title: Implicit flow still in use
tests.lookFor: response_type=token

tests.title: OIDC nonce missing or unverified
tests.lookFor: no nonce in the request, or not checked in the id_token

tests.title: id_token signature or issuer not validated
tests.lookFor: validation flags disabled; metadata fetched over HTTP
tests.expected: full validation; metadata over HTTPS with pinned issuer

tests.title: Token audience not checked against this application
tests.lookFor: ValidateAudience false, or a shared audience across services

tests.title: Scope or claim not enforced at the resource
tests.lookFor: token accepted without checking required scope/claim

tests.title: SAML signature not verified or partially verified
tests.lookFor: assertion consumed without verifying the signature over the whole response
tests.expected: signature verified; reference resolved to the signed element

tests.title: SAML signature wrapping (XSW)
tests.lookFor: assertion located by XPath/search rather than by signed reference
tests.expected: only the signed assertion is consumed

tests.title: SAML replay / conditions not enforced
tests.lookFor: NotBefore, NotOnOrAfter, Recipient, InResponseTo unchecked
tests.expected: all conditions validated; assertion ids cached against replay

tests.title: IdP metadata or signing certificate not pinned
tests.lookFor: metadata fetched dynamically with no trust anchor
tests.expected: certificate pinned; rotation is a deliberate change

tests.title: Post-login redirect not constrained
tests.lookFor: ReturnUrl used without IsLocalUrl / allow-list

tests.title: Account linking by unverified email
tests.lookFor: external identity matched to a local account by email alone

tests.title: HTTP request smuggling (CL.TE / TE.CL)
tests.lookFor: a proxy and origin disagreeing on Content-Length vs Transfer-Encoding

tests.title: Host header injection

tests.title: Password-reset link built from the Host header

tests.title: Web cache poisoning via unkeyed input
tests.lookFor: response varying on a header that is not part of the cache key
tests.expected: all response-influencing inputs keyed, or caching disabled

tests.title: Cache deception on authenticated pages
tests.lookFor: a static-looking extension causing an authenticated response to be cached

tests.title: HTTP response splitting
tests.lookFor: CR/LF reaching a response header or a redirect location

tests.title: X-Forwarded-For trusted without a known proxy
tests.lookFor: client IP taken from a header with no ForwardedHeaders known-proxy config

tests.title: Authorization decision based on a spoofable header
tests.lookFor: role or identity taken from a custom request header

tests.title: HTTP method override honoured
tests.lookFor: X-HTTP-Method-Override changing the effective verb

tests.title: Verb tampering bypasses authorization

tests.title: Path normalisation differences between proxy and app
tests.lookFor: encoded traversal or dot-segments reaching the app differently than the proxy saw

tests.title: Culture-sensitive string comparison in a security decision
tests.lookFor: ToLower()/ToUpper()/string.Equals without StringComparison.Ordinal for roles, paths or tokens

tests.title: Non-constant-time secret comparison
tests.lookFor: == or SequenceEqual comparing tokens, HMACs or API keys

tests.title: Unicode normalisation or homograph confusion in identifiers

tests.title: Integer overflow in a financial or size calculation

tests.title: Insecure temporary file creation

tests.title: Recursive delete or move with a user-influenced path

tests.title: DbContext shared across threads

tests.title: async void outside an event handler

tests.title: Fire-and-forget task loses exceptions

tests.title: CancellationToken ignored

tests.title: Exception filters or catch blocks hiding security failures
